seed: A laptop-sized window (1200 by 720, so the dock has 688 points to work with) and a Button component dropped twice. The Layout section used to be by far the tallest thing in the panel: 269 points for a copy and 489 for an original, most of it a paragraph restating the controls two rows above it and four padding side fields that folded open underneath the row. This walk reads the dock's own offsets back rather than trusting a picture, and makes three claims: the section is far shorter than it was for both a copy and an original, opening the four sides now costs the panel NOTHING because they come out in a popout, and one number typed over the row still reaches all four sides so nothing became unsettable.

steps.note: THE CLAIM: a copy of a component picked. Layout ran 502-771 (269 points) before 2026-09-06, with two three-line paragraphs in it. It should now be well under 200, its Arrangement row should read Free as a plain word, and its Padding row should be ONE row saying Mixed, since a Button keeps 9 above and below and 16 beside.

THE OTHER CLAIM: the original picked. Layout ran 585-1074 (489 points), of which 79 was a five-line paragraph and 108 was the four padding side fields opening themselves. It should now be around 300, and Effects and Shadow should start that much nearer the top.

THE SECOND CLAIM: the small control still opens the four sides, so room on one edge is one press away and nothing became unsettable. The four come out in a popout OVER the row, so Layout is exactly as tall as it was in stage 2 rather than growing by four rows.
the popout shut again with Escape. Layout has not moved at all through stages 2, 3 and 4.

THE THIRD CLAIM: nothing became unsettable. One number typed over the closed field still gives every side the same, so the Button grows by the 4 it gained on the left and the right and the 11 it gained top and bottom.
